tasks.title: Money formatting and parsing
tasks.objective: Implement parse_amount(text: str) -> int and format_amount(minor_units: int) -> str in src/ledger/money.py. parse_amount parses string decimal amounts into integer minor units (cents), raising ValueError on malformed input. format_amount converts minor units back to a decimal string representation.

tasks.title: Account model and normal balance
tasks.objective: Implement AccountType enum (ASSET, LIABILITY, EQUITY, REVENUE, EXPENSE), Account dataclass (id: str, name: str, type: AccountType), and normal_balance(account_type: AccountType) -> str in src/ledger/accounts.py. normal_balance returns 'DEBIT' for ASSET and EXPENSE, and 'CREDIT' for LIABILITY, EQUITY, and REVENUE, raising ValueError for unknown types.
acceptance_criteria: Account dataclass stores id, name, type

tasks.title: Journal postings and entries
tasks.objective: Implement Side enum (DEBIT, CREDIT), Posting dataclass (account_id: str, amount_minor: int, side: Side), and JournalEntry dataclass (date: str, memo: str, postings: list[Posting]) in src/ledger/journal.py. JournalEntry.__post_init__ raises ValueError when total debit amount_minor does not equal total credit amount_minor, or when len(postings) < 2.
acceptance_criteria: JournalEntry raises ValueError with unbalanced postings
JournalEntry raises ValueError with fewer than 2 postings

tasks.title: Ledger engine
tasks.objective: Implement the `Ledger` class in `src/ledger/ledger.py` and the `JournalEntry` class in the same file `src/ledger/ledger.py`. The `Ledger` class must expose the methods `add_entry(self, entry: JournalEntry)`, `balance_of(self, account_id: str) -> int`, `balances(self) -> dict`, and `is_balanced(self) -> bool`. The `JournalEntry` class must be instantiable with no required arguments for the happy path (`JournalEntry()`). Ensure all imports within `ledger.py` resolve and that the module `src.ledger.ledger` imports successfully without raising errors.
acceptance_criteria: is_balanced returns True when debits equal credits

tasks.title: Trial balance report
tasks.objective: Implement trial_balance(ledger: Ledger) -> list[TrialBalanceRow] in src/ledger/trial_balance.py. TrialBalanceRow is a dataclass with account_id: str, debit_total: int, credit_total: int.
acceptance_criteria: debit_total and credit_total are computed correctly per account

tasks.title: Financial reports
tasks.objective: Implement income_statement(ledger: Ledger, start: str, end: str) -> dict and balance_sheet(ledger: Ledger, as_of: str) -> dict in src/ledger/reports.py. Returns summary dictionaries of revenues/expenses and assets/liabilities/equity.
acceptance_criteria: income_statement returns dict of revenues and expenses
balance_sheet returns dict of assets, liabilities, and equity

tasks.title: CSV import and CLI
tasks.objective: Implement parse_csv(text: str) -> list[JournalEntry] in src/ledger/csv_import.py and main(argv: list[str]) -> int in src/ledger/cli.py. parse_csv parses date, memo, account, side, and amount columns. main reads a CSV file path from argv and prints a trial balance, returning 0 on success.
acceptance_criteria: parse_csv parses CSV text into JournalEntry objects
main reads file path and prints trial balance returning 0
